from PyQt5.QtWidgets import *
from PyQt5.uic import *
from pickle import dump, load
from numpy import array
def lettreEspace(ch):
    test=True
    i=0
    while i<len(ch) and test:
        if not("A"<=ch[i].upper()<="Z" or ch[i]==" "):
            test=False
        i=i+1
    return test
def verif():
    cin=w.cin.text()
    np=w.np.text()
    if not(len(cin)==8 and  cin.isdecimal() and cin[0] in ["0","1"]):
        QMessageBox.critical(w,"Erreur","N° CIN invalide!!")
    elif np=="" or lettreEspace(np)==False:
        QMessageBox.critical(w,"Erreur","Vérifier votre nom et votre prénom !!")
    else: # tous est OK
        calculer()
def calculer():
    s=0
    cb1=w.cb1.isChecked()
    cb2=w.cb2.isChecked()
    cb3=w.cb3.isChecked()
    rb1=w.rb1.isChecked()
    rb2=w.rb2.isChecked()
    cmb=w.combo1.currentText()
    if cb2 and cb3 and not(cb1):
        s=s+1
    if rb1:
        s=s+2
    if cmb=="40":
        s=s+3
    w.labScore.setText(str(s))
    enregistrerDansFichier(w.np.text(),w.cin.text(),s)
def enregistrerDansFichier(nom,cin,score):
    f=open("Reponses.dat","ab")
    e=dict()
    e["NCIN"]=cin
    e["NomPrenom"]=nom
    e["Score"]=score
    dump(e,f)
    f.close()
    
        
    #---------Programme principal--------  
app=QApplication([])
w=loadUi("Interface_Candidat.ui")
w.show()
w.Valider.clicked.connect(verif)
app.exec()
